pages.title: Dr. Irena Arslanova | Cognitive neuroscientist
pages.description: Irena Arslanova is a cognitive neuroscientist and Leverhulme Early-Career Fellow at Royal Holloway, University of London, studying how the heartbeat shapes our experience of time.
